learning_outcomes.text: Solves to the equilibrium problems using vectoral methods
Obtain the gravitational acceleration with different methods
Applies elastic, inelastic collisions and conservation of energy
Measures physical quantities as the angular velocity, angular acceleration and the moment of inertia
Measures the moments of inertia of rigit bodies having different geometric shapes

syllabus_topics: Basic concepts in occupational health and safety. Introduction of tools to be used in Mechanical Laboratory and issues to be considered in terms of occupational health and safety during the use of these tools. Use of graph paper.
Investigation of Potential Energy Change and Simple Vibratory Motion in a Helical Spring
Center of Mass and Equilibrium of Bodies
Finding Gravitational Acceleration with a Simple Pendulum
Angular Velocity, Angular Acceleration and Torque
